instruction: Computer, open the browsing history page so I can review the websites I've visited recently.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's history page (chrome://history/). This maintains similarity to the original task in both difficulty and interaction pattern - a simple navigation to a Chrome internal page. The evaluator uses existing functions: is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the active tab URL matches chrome://history/.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to open Chrome's browsing history page
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) properly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree's address bar
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly compares URLs while ignoring query parameters, which is appropriate for this task
Expected value 'chrome://history/' is semantically correct for Chrome's history page
Complete coverage: instruction requires opening history page, evaluator checks exactly that state
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric compares to expected URL -> returns match result
The goto_prefix='' configuration is correct since chrome:// URLs don't need a prefix added
